sources.fullCitation: The Marc Lavry Heritage Society. “Biography: European Period — Germany.” marclavry.org. Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot, 13 April 2026.
sources.researchNote: Records that Lavry moved to Berlin in 1927, was music director and conductor for Rudolf von Laban’s dance theatre, wrote music for Max Reinhardt’s productions and for films, conducted the Berliner Sinfonie Orchester from 1928 until the orchestra was dismantled under the National Socialist regime, and left for Riga in 1933. The site no longer serves the page; cited from the Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot of 13 April 2026.
